extras: Free tier allows 3 total sync notes; Pro required for unlimited syncing.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that turns your accumulated daily and periodic notes into an upper-level synthesis: monthly and quarterly rollups, recurring themes, open loops, and what you said versus what you did.
problem: Daily notes accumulate without a way to see the throughline, making it difficult to track intentions, unresolved questions, or recurring themes.
summary: A tool that synthesizes daily and periodic notes into upper-level reports, identifying recurring themes, open loops, and commitments.
